reason: VDV 301-2 V2.0 section 6.1.3.3 defines a prefixed minus sign as XML-choice notation, not as a negative multiplicity bound.

rules: lower-case element prefixes enumerate choice alternatives

finding_updates.summary: Leading-minus values are valid VDV choice notation. Remaining issue is incomplete/ambiguous application in the checked VideoLive tables, including missing visible a/b alternative labels and minus markers only on selected enum-valued fields.
finding_updates.effect_on_related_finding: VLS-002 remains executable-confirmed; its decisive plain 1:1 multi-field PDF rows still conflict with the V2.0 XSD-wide xs:choice.

finding_updates.summary: The -1:1 markers are valid VDV XML-choice notation. V2.0 visibly labels State as a and StartStopMode as b; V2.4 visibly uses a VideoRecordingState / b OperationErrorMessage.
finding_updates.effect_on_related_finding: VRS-003 remains executable-confirmed but is refined: V2.0 PDF has ordinary required AlarmArchiveFillLevel and OperationErrorMessage plus an a/b choice between State and StartStopMode, whereas the XSD places all four inside one xs:choice.

finding_updates.summary: The minus sign itself is valid choice notation. The remaining anomaly is a visible single a choice label without a peer b alternative while surrounding rows remain ordinary multiplicities.
finding_updates.effect_on_related_finding: VDS-002/VDS-004 remain executable-confirmed because the PDF leaves ViewID/ViewName and CurrentViewID/OperationErrorMessage as ordinary non-choice rows while the XSD puts all members in xs:choice.

ev103_status.note: Executable XSD outcomes do not change. Only the PDF-side interpretation wording is corrected/refined.

precedence: This correction overlay and updated current service registers supersede conflicting earlier Deep Read report sections and deltas. Historical reports remain audit snapshots.
